summary: Package fetches and executes remote JavaScript from mutable Bitbucket branch
details: The package's sole behavior is to fetch HTML from a hardcoded Bitbucket raw URL on the mutable `main` branch of an anonymous account (`p2p-alt-public/p2p-emis/raw/main/GameWebSight`), parse it, re-create `<script>` elements from the response, and append them to `document.body` for execution. The fetched content is unpinned, unauthenticated, and controlled by a third-party account unaffiliated with any established publisher; whoever controls that repository can push arbitrary JavaScript that runs in the origin of every consumer application that bundles this package. The package name resembles a legitimate 'buildsight' project but ships only this remote-loader shim.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
